curses.screen.title: Curses
curses.create.tooltip: Choose curses that affect the whole world.
curses.panel.hint: Click a curse to see what it does
curses.command.none: No curses are active in this world.
curse.curses.famine.name: Famine
curse.curses.quick_fuse.name: Quick Fuse
curse.curses.deluge.name: Deluge
curse.curses.deluge.description: Increased chance of rain and thunderstorms
curse.curses.hypocrisy.name: Hypocrisy
curse.curses.hypocrisy.description: Undead, Piglins and Illagers have a chance to spawn with a Totem of Undying
curse.curses.entangle.name: Entangle
curse.curses.entangle.description: Spiders leave webs in their wake and attempt to catch players with them
curse.curses.payload.name: Payload
curse.curses.payload.description: Phantoms pick up creepers and drop them on players. If you wall yourself in, they blast through your roof
curse.curses.insomnia.name: Insomnia
curse.curses.bastion.name: Bastion
curse.curses.bastion.description: Zombies, Skeletons and Piglins have a chance to spawn with a shield in their off hand and use it like a player would
curse.curses.infest.name: Infest
curse.curses.nocturne.name: Nocturne
curse.curses.nocturne.description: Phantoms spawn every night regardless of sleep, in caves, and above your roof if you build high
curse.curses.unity.name: Unity
curse.curses.unity.description: Hostile mobs never get aggravated at each other
curse.curses.coven.name: Coven
curse.curses.coven.description: Witches spawn much more often, at night and in caves. They drink Levitation to reach you on a tower, throw Milk to strip your buffs, and put out burning allies with Water and heal them with Regeneration
curse.curses.incendiary.name: Incendiary
curse.curses.incendiary.description: Villagers you anger, by hurting them or attacking an Iron Golem, throw Molotov Cocktails at you. Creepers cause fire when they explode
curse.curses.fortified.name: Fortified
curse.curses.fortified.description: Villages spawn with 3 Iron Golems. A golem you have angered runs away and hides if you get out of its reach (a tower, a ledge), and charges again when you come down
curse.curses.ordnance.name: Ordnance
curse.curses.ordnance.description: Skeletons may carry exploding arrows and witches may throw dynamite. If you wall yourself in, they use them to blast their way to you
curse.curses.warping.name: Warping
curse.curses.warping.description: Undead and Piglins have a chance to spawn with an Ender Pearl in their off hand, which they will use to get to you
curse.curses.inferno.name: Inferno
curse.curses.inferno.description: Blazes and Magma Cubes spawn in lava pools in the overworld
curse.curses.brittle.name: Brittle
curse.curses.brittle.description: Armor and tools lose durability faster
curse.curses.sagacious.name: Sagacious
curse.curses.omniscience.name: Omniscience
curse.curses.omniscience.description: Hostile mobs have infinite detection range: they always know where you are, within render distance. Endermen, creepers and witches dig one shared tunnel through rock and walls to reach you, blasting it open as they go, and every other mob follows it
curse.curses.inconspicuous.name: Inconspicuous
curse.curses.inconspicuous.description: Creepers have a chance to spawn 80% transparent. These creepers make no sound when they ignite
curse.curses.kiting.name: Kiting
curse.curses.kiting.description: Ranged mobs back away from you while attacking, and hide behind structures and other mobs between shots
curse.curses.selective_breeding.name: Selective Breeding
curse.curses.selective_breeding.descript: Pigs are Hoglins. Cows and Mooshrooms are Ravagers
curse.curses.beast_of_burden.name: Beast of Burden
curse.curses.beast_of_burden.description: Hostile mobs look for horses, donkeys, mules and spiders to ride, and ride them to you. Skeletons and Zombies have a 1% chance to spawn on a Skeleton Horse or Zombie Horse. A horse, donkey or mule always runs and obeys its rider; a spider stays in control of itself, climbing to reach you, and when it carries a ranged mob it holds its distance and backs away once you are in firing range
curse.curses.breach.name: Breach
curse.curses.breach.description: Endermen move blocks you placed and build stairs and bridges for mobs that cannot reach you. Undead and Piglins break blocks with their bare hands to get to you
curse.curses.tools.name: Tools
curse.curses.tools.description: Zombies have a chance to spawn with a pickaxe or an axe, and use it to dig through blocks to get to you
curse.curses.sunproof.name: Sunproof
curse.curses.sunproof.description: Mobs do not catch fire in sunlight
